answer: Sybil resistance via jetty berth metering: identity is issued only after a hull occupies a jetty berth and burns a mooring fee priced per keel, so each puppet pays its own fee with no bulk discount exists. Operation: the kernel validates the lease, opens a tide window of randomized probes, then mints identity; a zephyr of arrivals queues, one berth per hull. Attacker cost: n puppets need n berths and n burned fees, so marginal cost grows linearly with n; an honest agent pays once, and burned capital is never refundable.
